title: passiflora foetida var. quinqueloba
intro: Passiflora foetida var. quinqueloba, commonly known as yellow passion flower, is a plant species within the Passifloraceae family. It has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including anxiety, insomnia, and seizures, due to its potential health benefits such as sedative and anticonvulsant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides that contribute to its sedative and antispasmodic effects. Additionally, the bioactive constituents in yellow passion flower, including flavonoids and alkaloids, may provide antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties.
